_comment: Mutation testing for the modules that hold credentials and gate publishing. Coverage says a line ran; mutation testing says an assertion would have noticed it change. See docs/mutation-testing.md for why the scope is these three files.
_thresholds_comment: break is a ratchet, not a target. Four runs of the same code scored 36.33 (CI), 36.41, 36.41 and 36.49 — perTest coverage analysis is slightly non-deterministic under concurrency. 35 sits below that band with room to spare, so a real regression fails the build and jitter does not. Raise it as the score improves; never lower it to make a red build green.
